title: A High-Order Conformal FEM for Multidimensional Nonlinear Collisional Breakage Equations: Analysis and Computation
summary: Particle breakage due to collisional interactions plays a vital role in the development of several phenomena in science and engineering. The nonlinear collisional breakage equations (NCBEs) are a significant set of equations in this context. Solving the NCBE is computationally challenging due to its nonlinearity, high dimensionality, and complex kernel interactions. Solving NCBE problems is more complex in two- and three-dimensional problems.
